import json,collections
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(a)==len(items)==74
assert [x['item_id'] for x in a]==[x['item_id'] for x in items]
for i,d in zip(items,a):
 expected={str(n) for n in range(1,i['slots']+1)}
 assert set(d['slots'])==expected,(i['item_id'],'slot coverage')
 assert set(d['confidence'])==expected
 assert set(d['slots'].values())<={'ъ','ь','other','u'}
 assert set(d['confidence'].values())<={'high','low'}
 assert d['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
 assert isinstance(d['unmarked_final_hard_signs'],list)
c=collections.Counter(v for d in a for v in d['slots'].values())
print('Validated: 74 items; matching order; complete slot and confidence coverage.')
print('Slot calls:',dict(c),'total:',sum(c.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(d['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for d in a))
